title: Lulu's Beef & Broccoli Fried Rice
ingredients: Beef & Marinade: 500g lean steak, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp dark soy, 1 tsp baking soda, 2 tsp cornstarch
Sauce: 2 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp dark soy, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine, 1 tbsp coconut sugar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 0.5 tsp Chinese 5 spice, 0.5 tsp white pepper, 2 tbsp water
Base: 0.5 tbsp oil, 4 cups day-old jasmine rice, 4 cups small broccoli florets
Aromatics: 5 cloves minced garlic, 2 tsp ginger paste, 3 spring onions (whites and greens separated)
Toppings: 4 fried eggs, chilli oil, sesame seeds
steps: Marinate sliced beef with oyster sauce, dark soy, baking soda, cornstarch, and white pepper for 15 mins.
Mix all sauce ingredients in a small bowl, then cover broccoli with boiling water for 1-2 mins and drain.
Heat a wok over high heat with a little oil, stir-fry beef for 2-3 mins until browned, then set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, and spring onion whites in oil for 1 min, then add rice and toast for 1-2 mins.
Add broccoli and sauce to the wok, toss for 1-2 mins until well coated.
Return beef to the pan with spring onion greens, toss until hot, and serve topped with a fried egg, chilli oil, and sesame seeds.
